name: poorvith-mp/skills-writing
description: A writing skill collection covering technical documentation, book writing, screenwriting, SOP writing, line editing, writing taste, executive summaries, talk writing, and translation. The sample skill, technical-docs, guides technical documentation writing.
install: npx skills add poorvith-mp/skills-writing, or install individual skills directly, or git clone plus copy of a skill folder (cp -R skills-writing/skills/<skill-id> ~/.gemini/skills/ pattern for Gemini CLI, with Claude Code copy route also documented)
